levels.title: Look at what you print
levels.body_md: Your loop finds the right choice correctly. Focus on the value you output for its position. What does the problem say about the first position?
levels.question_back: What should you output when the answer is the first choice?

levels.title: Zero-based vs one-based counting
levels.body_md: Loops often count starting from zero. Many problems number items starting from one. Think about how to convert between those two numberings.

levels.title: Line 9 prints wrong index
levels.body_md: Your check on `L9` is correct, but the value you print there is wrong. You print `i`, which starts at `0`. The problem asks for 1-based index, so the first item should be `1`.

levels.title: Add one to your answer
levels.body_md: Your idea of scanning all choices is correct and runs in O(N) time. The bug is only the numbering. Since your `i` runs from 0 to `n-1`, printing `i` is always one less than needed. You need to print one more than `i` on `L9`. Then the first choice gives 1 and the rest match the required 1-based positions.
